league.summary: League champions! 5 points ahead of Mount Vernon Christian, with a perfect record.

insights.title: State spot locked in
insights.text: Even if we lose every remaining district game, we finish no worse than 3rd place — good enough for State.

insights.title: Perfect league season (9-0)
insights.text: That earned us the top seed in districts, which means a home game and the lowest-seeded opponent first.

insights.title: Providence Classical Christian plays us close
insights.text: We won both meetings, but only by one goal each time (3-2 and 4-3). They’re our next opponent: Thu Nov 5.

insights.title: Unbeaten all season
insights.text: 16 wins and 1 draw. We’ve scored 94 goals and allowed just 13.

insights.title: Defending State champions
insights.text: Fun fact: last year we lost a district game to Mount Vernon Christian and still won State. Once you’re in, districts only decide your ranking.
